## Outcome

Describe the user, operator, developer, or system outcome. Link the relevant
issue when one exists.

## What Changed

Explain the important implementation or documentation decisions. Call out any
public contract, security, compatibility, migration, or deployment effect.

## Verification

List the exact commands and manual checks performed, including anything that
could not be run.

- [ ] The diff has one coherent purpose and excludes unrelated changes.
- [ ] Tests and documentation are proportional to the risk of the change.
- [ ] Generated files were rebuilt from their tracked source.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private data, exam answers, or unsafe
      diagnostic material.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.

## Licensing and Provenance

- [ ] Existing copyright and license notices are preserved.
- [ ] New files carry the correct license and actual copyright holder.
- [ ] Copied or substantially adapted work records its exact repository,
      revision, path, license, and required notice.
- [ ] This pull request contains no undisclosed source-available or commercial
      upstream code.

Do not include undisclosed vulnerability details in a public pull request. Use
the process in `SECURITY.md`.
